axes.requirements: All ten acceptance criteria traced to implementation and evidence; direct OAuth connectors remain explicitly out of scope.
axes.architecture: Parser, planner, executor, persistence gateway, route, CLI, and React presentation remain separated and reuse ContactRepository/contact commands.
axes.security: Bounded streaming body, constant-time token check, owner binding, RLS, composite FKs, explicit owner filters, atomic receipts, no raw payload logs, and fail-closed live configuration.
axes.data_integrity: External-id/email/phone matching, fill-empty only, tag union, unsubscribe precedence, duplicate-row collapse, note idempotency, and explicit external-link collision failure.
axes.ux_accessibility: Apple-inspired tokens, system type, grouped surfaces, 44px controls, focus states, light/dark and reduced motion, transient PII, honest demo lock, and 390px no-overflow evidence.
axes.testing: 77 tests plus lint, typecheck, CLI preview/207/refusal checks, clean production build, route-level HTTP contracts, and browser validation with zero console warnings/errors.

findings_fixed: Undefined candidate keys cluttered the preview changes list.
Sequential receipt insertion did not close the concurrent same-key race.
Request byte limiting occurred after full body allocation.
External-link duplicate inserts could be ignored without proving the same contact.
Notes lacked a database-level composite owner/contact constraint.
Automatic intake accepted candidates without an external identity and oversized identities were not bounded.
Multiple rows targeting one existing contact were executed independently instead of collapsing deterministically.
A create-to-external-link failure could leave an unlinked new contact without compensation.
Partial outcomes were visually and operationally indistinguishable from clean success.
The advertised file size exceeded the framework Server Action default.
The CLI did not fail on local rejections or HTTP 207 responses.
The intake route lacked handler-level contract tests and Connections overstated Mailchimp status.
remaining_external_evidence: Apply migration 0002 to a provisioned Supabase project.
Configure service-role, owner ID, and bearer token before exercising a real automatic intake write.
Obtain vendor credentials and separate stories before claiming direct OAuth/pull connectors.
